bias_note: Lean: bearish open. NQ gaps down ~300+ pts on GOOGL, so Wednesday's lows and the overnight low are the first sell-side targets; the gap fill into Wed's close is the buy-side draw if it reverses. 8:30 AM Advance GDP + Core PCE + Claims hit before the open: a hot PCE with the 10Y above 5% extends the selloff, while a soft print could start a gap-fill rally. Let 9:30-10:00 show its hand; don't fade the gap blindly. AMZN, INTC, SNDK, COIN report Thu after the close, so Friday gaps again. Oil above $100 and Iran strike headlines are downside risks; a peace-talk headline (Vance outreach) is upside risk.

takeaway: Wed was a quiet hold: the Fed kept rates at 3.75-4.00% in a 10-2 vote (Cook and Hammack wanted a hike), and Warsh gave no December signal but sounded upbeat on growth. Nasdaq closed +0.27% at 26,550 with semis +1.75%, while the 10Y rose to 5.04% and WTI jumped ~3% to $102.8. The real move came after the bell: GOOGL -10% on its first miss in ~4 years and negative free cash flow from AI capex, NOW -18%, FTNT -26%. MSFT +2.6% (Azure +48%) only partly offsets it. NQ futures were -1.2% (~29,620) by 7:40 PM, and Dec hike odds rose to ~83%.
